author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: ESET found Russia-Linked APT group Turla using a new toolset, dubbed Cereal, on government Exchange servers in Kazakhstan and Romania. author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: A public iOS sandbox escape could expose wallet keys, Binance warns. No attacks are reported and no fix is confirmed. title: iOS Sandbox Escape Is Public, and Apple Hasn’t Confirmed a Fix

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Iris Ohyama warns that a cloud data breach may have exposed personal information of 7.7 million customers, including names and passwords.
